mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (item_id, buyer_id, rating, content, created_at) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{buyerId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.item_id, r.buyer_id, u.username AS buyer_username, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.buyer_id = u.id WHERE r.item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.item_id, r.buyer_id, u.username AS buyer_username, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.buyer_id = u.id WHERE r.item_id = #{itemId} AND r.buyer_id = #{buyerId} LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM reviews WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
SELECT item_id FROM reviews WHERE buyer_id = #{buyerId}
